Mismatch in VATEX codes VATEX-EU-D and VATEX-EU-F

It has been identified that there is a mismatch in the names of VATEX-EU-D and VATEX-EU-F codes between the VATEX code list itself and the EN 16931 list of codes in this document. In the case of VATEX-EU-F the context of Intracommunity-acquisition is left out in the EN16931 code listing. In the case if VATEX-EU-D the code is named for second hand transport in the VATEX code list but for travel agency scheme in the EN16931 listing. This mismatch has been since the first version of these codes. A correction will require a non-backwards compatible changed and is scheduled for the next release, due to be published in May 2026. Postponed to Nov 2026.
